description: Updates for the CLI, the docs site, the template and its add-ons. CI creates a game with every option on each update, so an update merges only when every option still works.

customManagers.description: Add-ons pin their packages in cli/template/extras/**/addon.json

packageRules.description: Released fixes for the dev tools we rely on come in at once, as pnpm's minimumReleaseAgeExclude allows
Patch and minor updates merge themselves once CI, with every created game, passes; majors wait for a person
